text:
Rules 1, 3 and 6 allow only one non-required service at a time, so the schedule is a single chain of one-month periods. This plan misses 66 (episode, follower) pairs and costs $87.94. I did not prove that no plan misses fewer. I compared about a dozen arrangements by hand, and this one missed the fewest.

**The plan, in order**

| Period | Service | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| Nov 1 – Nov 16 | Tidewell (already paid, free) | Nothing needed. No other service can run while it is on. |
| Nov 16 – Dec 16 | Marquee | Most of The Paper Tide and The Copper Lantern, and all of The Distant Meridian. |
| Dec 17 – Jan 17 | Lumen | All 21 pairs of The Quiet Atlas (all three followers can watch on Jan 11–12), plus Amber Kingdom episode 1. |
| Jan 17 – Feb 17 | Tidewell | Jun's live episodes of Copper Atlas and Velvet Harbor from Jan 19 to Feb 16. Rosa catches up on 17 earlier and current episodes. |
| Feb 17 – Mar 17 | Lumen | The Amber Kingdom episodes 6–10 and most of The Salt Tide. |
| Mar 17 – Apr 17 | Kestrel+ | All 30 pairs of The Quiet Archive (it drops Mar 23, and Jun's window is Mar 23–24). |

Pebble Kids is required, so its titles are always available and it is not listed.

**What gets missed (66 pairs)**

- **Nov 1–15, while Tidewell blocks everything else:**
  - Jun misses The Copper Lantern episodes 1–2 and The Paper Tide episode 1.
  - Wen misses Copper Lantern episode 1.
  - Jun misses Copper Atlas episode 1 (Dec 10), which falls inside the Marquee month.
- **Rest of Marquee after Dec 16:** 13 pairs (Paper Tide episodes 7–11 and Copper Lantern episode 7).
- **Kestrel+ before March:** Distant Garden (film) and The Hollow Ferry are lost (21 pairs). Covering them would have cost more elsewhere.
- **Tidewell outside its month:**
  - Episodes before Jan 17: 2 Jun pairs, plus 4 more where neither Jun nor Rosa saw them in time.
  - Velvet Harbor episode 11 (Feb 23) for both Jun and Rosa.
- **Lumen gaps:**
  - The Quiet Atlas for Jun is fine; the other losses are Amber Kingdom episodes 2–5, 11 and 12 for Wen.
  - The Salt Tide episodes 1–2 and episode 3 for Wen.

**Main trade-off**

Between Dec 16 and the Kestrel+ month there is room for exactly three one-month periods. Lumen, then Tidewell, then Lumen covered the most pairs of the arrangements I tried. The alternatives were:
- Putting Tidewell first instead of Lumen gave fewer.
- Extending Marquee for a second month gave fewer.
- Using Kestrel+ earlier gave fewer.

**Cost:** Marquee $13.99 + Lumen $15.49 × 2 + Tidewell $8.99 + Kestrel+ $17.99 = **$71.95**, plus the required Pebble Kids renewals of $7.99 × 2 = $15.98, for **$87.94** in total.
